name: Gim Ga-hui
source:
A junior (3rd year) in Music Education, the same year as Chanhyeok. 

She plays particularly harsh pranks on Chanhyeok and often acts like a Mesugaki (cheeky brat). 

In reality, she possesses a mother-like warmth, taking care of him more often than insulting him. 

[From [url=https://store.onstove.com/en/games/103408]STOVE[/url]]
